payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design an editorial magazine layout. Use: asymmetric grid, pull quotes, drop caps, multi-column text, large imagery, bylines, section dividers, print-inspired typography, article hierarchy, white space balance.
payload.best_for: News sites, blogs, magazines, editorial content, long-form articles, journalism, publishing
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: grid with named areas, column-count for text, ::first-letter for drop caps, blockquote styling, figure/figcaption, gap variations, font: serif for body, variable widths
payload.do_not_use_for: Dashboards, apps, e-commerce catalogs, real-time data, short-form content
payload.effects_and_animation: Smooth scroll, reveal on scroll, parallax images, text animations, page-flip transitions
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Grid asymmetric, ☐ Typography editorial, ☐ Pull quotes styled, ☐ Drop caps present, ☐ Images large/impactful, ☐ Mobile reflows well
payload.keywords: Magazine layout, asymmetric grid, editorial typography, pull quotes, drop caps, column layout, print-inspired
payload.primary_colors: High contrast: Black #000000, White #FFFFFF, accent brand color
payload.secondary_colors: Muted supporting, pull quote highlights, byline colors, section dividers
